_readme: Version badge and What's new list for the Beach Conditions panel. To announce an update: add an entry at the TOP of updates, then set version and date to match. Notes are for anglers: one short line each, no code talk. The panel shows the newest 5 entries. Bumping version shows a NEW dot to everyone until they open the list.

notes: New: Past Years. See how tonight's date fished over the last 5 years and the best weeks of the year at your beach.
Tap any week on the Past Years chart to see every night that week, then tap a night for its wind, surf, water temp and tide.
Past Years now adds a new night every day.
Weather alerts: every active NWS flood, storm, marine and surf alert for your beach's area.
Tonight's rank: see where your beach places among all the beaches we score.
Water temp now uses your beach's ocean reading instead of far-off bay sensors.
56 more beaches: 237 from Maine to Texas.
The Drop Score now counts bait running and a high tide in the evening window.
Too windy to fly: evenings averaging 25 mph or more are capped.
"Bait showing tonight?" Your yes/no reports now update the score.
